name: Floppy
idea: Your shooter starts under the basket and picks a side: one screen on the left, two on the right.
why: The defender has to guess which way the shooter will go. Whichever way the defender leans, the shooter runs the other way.
tryit: Shooter: watch your defender’s feet. If they step one way, sprint the other way and run right past your screener’s shoulder.

frames.say: {2} starts right under the basket. {4} waits on the left to set one screen, and {5} and {3} wait on the right to set two.
*Guess:* {X2} thinks {2} will use the two screens, so {X2} leans to the right.
{2} sees it and runs the other way, off {4}’s screen. {X2} runs into {4}!
Swish! Watch your defender, and go the way they’re not.
